title: Turku3D building description
description: What one building looks like, as measured data. See docs/specs/building-description.md.

measured.description: Colours measured without anybody reading the building: a robust sample of its wall in the nearest street panorama, of its roof in the orthophoto. The automatic tier draws them in the material the register or a reading gives; a described material always wins.

conf.description: Confidence 0..1 per field of the object that carries it. Key "*" is the default for every field of the object and of nested objects without their own conf.

src.description: `key` of one or more provenance entries.

cell.description: One grid cell: an opening type, or null for plain wall.

provenance.description: The envelope's provenance entry (docs/design/world-pipeline.md). `key` is what `src` fields refer to.

source.description: turku-lod2, turku-register, panorama, orthophoto, lidar, hand, prior, facade-program

register.description: Informative copy of register facts. The generator uses only storeys, year and material, and only as priors.

style.description: Selects the priors that fill every field the description leaves out.

material.description: A key of the top-level materials map, or an inline material.

colour2.description: Secondary colour: mortar, joints, battens, seams.

scale_m.description: Module size: visible board width, brick length, course height of ashlar, seam spacing, tile width, panel width.

shape.description: Outline other than a rectangle with a head: a round attic window, a hexagonal vent, a lunette.

recess_m.description: Depth of the glass or leaf behind the wall face.

multiple.description: Coupled openings sharing one cell, w_m each.

colour2.description: Colour of a panel's inset field and roundel.

glass.description: What shows in the glass: reflection strength and what stands behind it.

curtains.description: Share of windows of this type with curtains.

blinds.description: Share with blinds, at varied heights.

passage.description: For a gateway: how deep it goes.

stallriser_m.description: Height of the solid base under the glass.

transom_h_m.description: Height of a row of top lights; 0 for none.

material.description: Infill of a blind opening or a vent.

lights.description: How the glazed area is divided.

transom_at.description: Height of the transom as a share of the opening height, from the bottom.

placedOpening.description: An opening placed by measurement instead of by the bay grid. w_m and h_m override the type.

u_m.description: Centre, from the wall's left end as seen from outside.

v_m.description: Bottom edge above the wall base. In a storey: omit to use the storey's sill_m.

sill_m.description: Bottom of the grid openings above this storey's floor.

window.description: Opening type of every bay of this storey.

row.description: Opening type per bay, left to right; replaces window. Length = number of bays.

material.description: Wall material of this storey's band.

relief.description: Surface relief of a wall zone.

first_m.description: Centre of the first bay; omit to centre the grid on the wall.

bayGrid.description: A regular rhythm. With count: that many bays. With pitch_m alone: as many as fit the wall, centred; this is how wall_defaults serves walls of any width.

vAnchor.description: A height tied to the storey stack instead of a measured v_m.

storey.description: Index into the expanded storey list, bottom = 0; negative counts from the top.

band.description: A horizontal part running along the wall.

v_m.description: Bottom edge above the wall base.

vertical.description: A vertical part on the wall face.

where.description: Placement by rule instead of u_m.

courses.description: Pale courses across a pilaster or pier (banded brick piers): one every pitch_m from first_m over its foot, height_m high and width_m wide, standing out by projection_m more than the pilaster.

zone.description: A rectangle of wall with its own material; later zones lie over earlier ones.

storeys.description: Expanded storey indexes that have this balcony.

v_m.description: Slab top above the wall base, for a single balcony placed by measurement.

glazing.description: Glass panes close the front from the railing to the slab above. The glazed type has it unless false.

attachment.description: A part fixed to the wall.

v_m.description: Bottom edge above the wall base.

type.description: Variant. porch: open, glazed, boarded. canopy: slab, glazed, pitched, hood, entablature. sign: fascia, projecting, letters, board, lightbox. steps: straight, side.

base_m.description: Height of the supports' feet above the ground: a step or podium they stand on.

frame.description: Where the wall stands. u runs from p0 to p1, left to right as seen from outside; v runs up from base_h.

base_h.description: N2000 height of v = 0; omit for the lowest point of the shell wall.

height_m.description: Height of the wall face as observed, for the fit against the shell.

like.description: Id of the wall whose fields this wall inherits.

hidden_m.description: Rectangles [u0, v0, u1, v1] nobody could see (trees, vehicles, hoardings).

ground_floor_m.description: Height of the lowest storey's floor above the wall base; omit for the plinth height.

openings.description: Openings outside the storey grid; v_m is required here.

roofAnchor.description: A place on the roof: a point, or a position above a described wall.

roof.description: The roof form comes from LoD2. This says what covers it and what stands on it.

verge.description: The sloping edge at a gable.

rise_m.description: Height of the gable triangle; two fifths of h_m when absent.

h_m.description: Height above the roof surface at its upper side.

component.description: A named parametric landmark part from the component kit.

at.description: [E, N] or [E, N, H] for a part not tied to a wall.

sitePart.description: A part of the plot that belongs to the building's street face: a board fence with its gateway, a plot wall.

s_m.description: Centre, as distance along the path.

shell.description: The LoD2 geometry and its surroundings, written by describe() from source data; a stored description never carries it.

rings.description: Outer ring, then holes; counter-clockwise seen from outside; not closed.

terrain.description: Ground heights around the footprint: polylines of [E, N, H].

neighbours.description: Buildings that touch this one: where a wall is a party wall, it gets no openings.

top_h.description: Height of the neighbour's wall top.

passages.description: Where a way at ground level runs through or along the ground storey (building passages, arcades): the open area inside the footprint, from the open map's covered ways and the street register's part under the building. Only present where there is one.

polygons.description: Polygons of [E, N]: outer ring, then holes; counter-clockwise; not closed.

clear_m.description: Clear height under the soffit from the map (maxheight); null: the generator's default.

measuredColour.description: A colour sampled from photographs of one part of the building, with how sure the sample is.

spread.description: CIELAB dE of the sampled pixels round their median.

share.description: Share of the sampled strip that was used.

visible.description: Share of the part free of trees, vehicles and fences in the panoramas used.

agreement.description: CIELAB distance between the panoramas used and the colour (lower: they agree).

n.description: Different panoramas the colour was measured in.

from.description: The panorama the colour mainly comes from: provider, id, capture date and how overcast its light was (0 sunny .. 1 overcast).

reliefPart.description: A flat shape standing out of the wall: a coping, a gable panel, a pier panel, an arch's voussoirs. Extruded from offset_m to offset_m + depth_m in front of the wall face (offset may be negative: a panel set into the wall).

polygon_m.description: Outline in wall (u, v) metres, v from the wall base.

anchor_m.description: A point [u, v] the part belongs to: it is built only where the shell wall covers this point (a part of a front that spans several shell walls goes on the one that holds it). Default: a point inside the part.
